question: How do I keep travel notes?

sections.title: Open trip notes for the current trip
items: Click Dashboard in the toolbar.
Open Trip personal > Notes.
Plantour opens the Trip notes page for the currently selected trip.
sections.afterHtml: If the wrong trip opens, select the correct trip first and then return to Notes.

sections.title: Add, update, or delete a trip note
sections.beforeHtml: Use trip notes when you want to keep travel information, plans, reminders, or image-based references inside the selected trip.
items: Use Add to create a new trip note.
Enter a required title.
Optionally choose an activity if you want to connect the note to one activity.
Enter note content in the editor. Plantour requires meaningful content before saving.
Click Submit to save the note.
Select a saved note and use Update to edit it, or Delete to remove it.

sections.title: Use the notes editor
items: The editor toolbar lets you format text with bold, italic, underline, strike, headings, bullet lists, ordered lists, block quotes, links, and unlink.
Use Image URL when you want to insert an image directly from a normal image link.
Use Browse Dropbox when you want to insert a private Dropbox image without exposing a public shared link.
When you reopen a note, Plantour restores the saved rich-text content and image references in the editor.

sections.title: Add your Dropbox key in Plantour
sections.beforeHtml: Plantour reads a Dropbox access token from your active dropbox key. The server uses that token to browse folders and download private images for the editor, note list, and note PDFs.
items: Open the Dropbox developer console and create a scoped access app for the Dropbox account that stores your note images.
Choose an app access level that can see the files you want to use. If your images are outside a Dropbox app folder, choose Full Dropbox access.
In the app permissions, enable at least files.metadata.read and files.content.read.
Generate an access token for that app in Dropbox.
Open Keys in Plantour.
Create or update a key with the name dropbox.
Paste the Dropbox access token into the key value. Plantour also accepts a value that starts with Bearer , but a plain token is simpler.
Mark that key as active and save it.
sections.afterHtml: If Plantour says that the active dropbox key is missing or that Dropbox browsing cannot load, first check that the key is active and then confirm the token still works and still has files.metadata.read and files.content.read permissions.

sections.title: Add a private Dropbox image step by step
sections.beforeHtml: Private Dropbox images require an active dropbox key in your Keys first. Without that key, the Dropbox browser page cannot load your private images.
items: Open Trip personal > Notes and create a new note or open an existing note for editing.
Enter the note title and any text you want to keep.
Click Browse Dropbox in the editor toolbar.
Plantour opens the Dropbox browser page and keeps a draft of your note so you can return to it.
Browse folders until you find the image file you want.
Select the file so Plantour loads its preview.
Click To Note or the submit action for the selected image to return to the note form.
Plantour restores your draft note and inserts the selected Dropbox image into the editor as a private Dropbox reference.
Click Submit to save the note with that image.
sections.afterHtml: Plantour keeps the Dropbox image private by storing a protected Dropbox reference instead of a public shared link. The note editor and note list can still resolve and preview that image for you, and marked note PDFs use the same private image resolution flow.

sections.title: Review notes, connect them to activities, and export them
items: Use the list filters such as Filter by Title and Activity when you want to narrow the notes list.
Use the page menu option Show Activity Select or Hide Activity Select when you want to show or hide the activity selector in the list.
Mark notes with Mark for PDF when you want to include them in an exported document.
Use Download Marked Notes PDF from the page menu when you want a PDF export of the marked notes only.
